author: Jo10843
body: I was banned for hacking with the Weepcraft client. I believe that I should be unbanned from the server because I have changed my ways. This post is a sincere apology for any emotional damage that I may have caused because of my misguided hacking spree. My ban wan not false by any means, and I have no evidence to show the staff that it was false. The total time I have been banned is about 7 months (or so my profile says). I have never been ban evading ever, and i have never appealed a ban before.
